name: 62226 · Swansea, IL
findings: ZIP 62226 (Swansea) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62226 (Swansea) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 62226 (Swansea) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
